resolutions.rationale: Verified against `src/app/extension/taiknr.ts:19-28` and `src/infra/pi-event-handlers/session-start.ts:14-15`: `taiknr(pi)` keeps `const session = createSessionConfig()` inside its closure and registers no `/taiknr` command in this card (`D10`), so `archive-session.test.ts` loading `taiknr` into `createAgentSession` has no handle to call `session.setEnabled(...)` directly, and without `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` + temp `cwd` isolation `session_start` would read `~/.pi/agent/pi-taiknr.json`. Not churn: reverting Round 1's `ST-S3-1` patch would re-open missing `D5`/`R-12` test coverage; relocating the `setEnabled` mid-session cases to handler-level `createGatedPi` tests while keeping config-file `enabled: false` + `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` isolation in `archive-session.test.ts` satisfies both `ST-S3-1` and `CR-S3-R2-1` with `taiknr.ts` untouched.
